Getting started

Run the current workspace prototype

  1. Run bun install to install Astro, SolidJS, and shared workspace packages.
  2. Run cargo test to execute Rust unit and smoke tests.
  3. Run cargo run -p webox-browser-app to boot the browser shell prototype.
  4. Run bun run docs:dev to view the Astro docs and marketing site.
Built inside the webox monorepo for product storytelling and developer onboarding.
